Kill2BeansDescription: I had planned a quiet day. The beans had other plans. Defeat two of them so I can get back to work without checking behind me every few seconds. I would rather spend my breaks sitting down.
Kill2BeansCompleteDescription: Two fewer interruptions. I might even finish something before my next break. No promises.
Collect2CansDescription: I need two cans to sort a few small things. Buying proper containers would mean admitting this is a permanent hobby. Bring me the cans and we can keep calling it a quick tidy-up.
Collect2CansCompleteDescription: Perfect. One for useful things and one for things I have not found a use for yet.
Collect2FishDescription: Fish is on the menu. That was easy to decide; getting the fish is the part still outstanding. Bring me two fish so lunch can move beyond the planning stage. There has been plenty of planning.
Collect2FishCompleteDescription: Two fish. Good. We now have ingredients instead of intentions.
Collect2PurpleOresDescription: I need two pieces of purple ore for smelting practice. Working on technique sounds better than making the same thing again, but both require materials. Bring two pieces and I can get started.
Collect2PurpleOresCompleteDescription: That will do. Time to find out whether the practice has been helping.
Collect2WhiteOresDescription: I am two pieces of white ore short. I checked twice, in case counting was cheaper than another mining trip. It was not. Bring me the missing ore so I can get on with the smelting.
Collect2WhiteOresCompleteDescription: Everything is here now. Finding another excuse to delay will take some effort.
Collect2CopperOresDescription: Every time I need copper ore, I have just used the last piece. Bring me two pieces for a small reserve. I expect it to last right up until I need copper ore again.
Collect2CopperOresCompleteDescription: A reserve at last. I already have a use for it, which may explain the problem.
Collect2BlackOresDescription: Two pieces of black ore would finish my materials list. The list looked much shorter before I had to carry any of it. Bring those last two pieces and I can stop calling the collection almost ready.
Collect2BlackOresCompleteDescription: Materials gathered. Carrying them around apparently counts as its own profession.
Collect2ChamomileDescription: A proper break needs a cup of something warm. Mine currently needs chamomile. Bring me two flowers before I decide that standing beside an empty cup counts as resting.
Collect2ChamomileCompleteDescription: That is the tea sorted. Now for the difficult part: leaving the work alone for five minutes.
Collect2WoodsDescription: I have a small repair to do and need two logs. It should be a quick job. That is what I said before looking at my supplies, too. Bring the wood and I will make a more informed estimate.
Collect2WoodsCompleteDescription: Good wood. The repair is now officially more likely to happen.
Collect2CookedFishDescription: Snacking while working is convenient, but apparently it does not count as a proper meal every time. Bring me two cooked fish. I will even sit down to eat them. A full lunch break, very ambitious.
Collect2CookedFishCompleteDescription: Lunch is ready. Everything else can wait until after lunch, as it should.
Collect2SushiDescription: Today I would like two portions of sushi. There is no special occasion. Having lunch is a perfectly adequate occasion, and I would appreciate the change. Bring me two portions before I settle for the usual.
Collect2SushiCompleteDescription: Exactly what I wanted. A little variety is worth putting on the schedule.
Collect2PurpleBarsDescription: I need two purple bars for my crafting supplies. Bars, rather than ore: I am trying to start a project without first starting three other jobs. Bring two and I can cross preparation off the list.
Collect2PurpleBarsCompleteDescription: Ready to use. That is a very pleasant thing for materials to be.
Collect2WhiteBarsDescription: Two white bars. I wrote it down this time, because going from memory has left me with plenty of everything except what I need. Bring me the bars and we can call this an organised afternoon.
Collect2WhiteBarsCompleteDescription: Two bars, exactly as written. I should try this list idea more often.
Collect2CopperBarsDescription: I need two copper bars. There were two here yesterday, but yesterday also had a project. Bring another pair and I will try to keep them for the work they were actually meant for.
Collect2CopperBarsCompleteDescription: These go straight into the supplies. No little side projects on the way.
Collect2BlackBarsDescription: Two black bars are all I still need. I realise I said almost finished a while ago. That referred to the planning. Bring the bars and the actual work can finally catch up.
Collect2BlackBarsCompleteDescription: That is everything. I now have materials, a plan, and considerably fewer excuses.
Collect2HealthPotionsDescription: I would like two health potions in reserve before my next practice session. I do intend to get hit less often. I also intend to be realistic about how quickly I learn. Bring two potions and both plans are covered.
Collect2HealthPotionsCompleteDescription: Good. Ideally these will stay unopened. I say that every time, but it is still the goal.
